item.title: fix(agents): preserve existing files after failed host writes (#118470)
item.summary: fix(agents): preserve existing files after failed host writes (#118470) Preserve existing unrestricted host files when a write or edit fails partway through by updating regular files in place and restoring the original prefix and length. Writable-but-unreadable regular files now fail before mutation. Co-authored-by: yetval Co-authored-by: Ayaan Zaidi
